homePageUrl.description: Home page or landing page of the application.

logoutUrl.description: URL used by the authorization service to sign out a user.

redirectUris.description: URIs to which Azure AD will redirect after authentication.

enableAccessTokenIssuance.description: Specifies whether web application can request an access token using OAuth 2.0 implicit flow.

enableIdTokenIssuance.description: Specifies whether web application can request an ID token using OAuth 2.0 implicit flow.
